items.title: Willie Foster Interview
items.q: Is that the one that George Delcy ran?

ctx.x: I don't know what it is.
Is that the one that George Delcy ran?

I think it was because they had two. They had one on Custom House Street, you know. They had one on Custom House Street, right on the other side of the basin. And then they had one right near the corner, the canal in Ramport, north Ramport.
